utf8:
# https://editorconfig.org/
root = true
# Conservatively avoid changing defaults for other file types, e.g. raw json files for test cases,
# Makefiles, etc.
[*.{cpp,h,md}]
charset                  = utf-8
end_of_line              = lf
indent_size              = 2
indent_style             = space
insert_final_newline     = true
tab_width                = 2
trim_trailing_whitespace = true
